description: This file defines a custom annotation @AddOnStartup used to annotate constants (such as privilege or role constants) for designation of their description and whether they are core constants. It includes metadata about licensing and package information.

classes.name: AddOnStartup
classes.description: Custom annotation used to describe constants in the PrivilegeConstants or RoleConstants class, including whether the constant is core and its description.

methods.name: description
methods.description: Annotation element that provides a textual description of the constant.

methods.name: core
methods.description: Annotation element that indicates whether the constant is a core constant (default true).
